svg.title: Mockup — Monitor consent and owner panel
svg.text: In game · Monitor — viewing consent (left) and owner panel (right), GUI scale 2
Scope copy matches the current grant (all open screens). Viewer rows say “allowed”; “watching now” only when the client actually observes it.
Consent: equal-weight buttons, focus starts on Deny, Esc denies, scope stated in the button.
Owner panel: Source · Your control · Viewers — revoke ≠ close capture.
Privacy chip is persistent
“Capturing · private” until someone is allowed, then signal-blue
“Sharing · N allowed”. Survives Hide HUD unless turned off explicitly.
Consent states consequence
Who, what (all open screens), that it can be revoked,
and what is NOT granted. Unverified offline names are labelled.
Grouped by meaning
Source, local control and viewer access are separate
groups with separate verbs.
Destructive verbs say what ends
“Revoke all viewers” keeps capturing; “Close capture”
ends the picture for everyone. Danger = text + edge.
Every row wraps or truncates the window title in the
middle; buttons never leave the panel.
Bindings, not prose
Keys come from the live bindings (Esc shown), not
hardcoded text; F8 / Shift+Esc listed where bound.
